findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 *        external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
select call, "Call to eval, exec or compile."
findings.hypothesis: Pydantic might use eval/exec for type resolution, potentially leading to code injection if inputs are untrusted.

message.text: Call to eval, exec or compile.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect eval usage
 * @description Inspect the arguments and context of the eval call in pydantic/v1/utils.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/inspect-eval
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Function f
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%pydantic/v1/utils.py%") and
  call.getScope() = f
select call, "Eval call in function " + f.getName() + " with arg: " + call.getArg(0).asExpr().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Inspect the eval call to understand its context and arguments.

message.text: Eval call in function in_ipython with arg: StringLiteral

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("dill").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization using pickle, yaml, marshal, or shelve.
